part.text:
Fixed `JsonPrimitive#equals` for large integral values in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/JsonPrimitive.java:292`. When either integral value is a `BigInteger`, equality now compares full `BigInteger` values instead of truncated `longValue()` results.

Also improved `getAsBigInteger` at `JsonPrimitive.java:170` to convert other integral types directly via `BigInteger.valueOf(long)`.

Validation: full `gson` module test suite passes — 1248 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors.
